title: Scope Analysis
description: Analyze Vercel parity scope against current SiteFlow codebase.
findings: Prioritize project/environment foundation, Git webhook/source events, worker build loop, production promotion/domain semantics, deployment observability, CLI parity, deploy hooks, and rolling release later.

title: Risk Analysis
description: Assess technical and project risks for Vercel parity.
findings: Highest risks are webhook security, secret redaction, build sandboxing, route drift, and premature rolling-release complexity. Mitigate with narrow MVPs, explicit state machines, and focused tests.

title: Dependency Analysis
description: Map feature ordering and critical path.
findings: Project/env model blocks Git deploys, CLI link, env pull, and deploy hooks. Git events block worker source builds. Production aliases block rollback and rolling release.

title: Roadmap Assembly
description: Synthesize tasks into phased execution plan.
findings: Created VP-001 through VP-008 roadmap and issue-backed task list under .workflow/design/siteflow-vercel-parity.
